product_title: Handcrafted Pink Lotus Decorative Tealight Holder Set
product_description: Add elegance to your festive decor with this handcrafted tealight holder set, featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, intricate golden detailing, mirror accents, and delicate pearl embellishments. Perfect for Diwali, pooja rooms, and festive table decor.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep decorative fabric and embellishments away from direct heat.
Place on a stable, heat-resistant surface when using tealights.
Store in a dry, protective box when not in use.
